# Key insights (auto-generated by `src/analyze.py`)

- **9,972 tickets** analysed; overall **SLA compliance 87.7%**, average TAT **15.2 h**, first-time-right **95.9%**.
- SLA compliance averaged **81.4%** before July 2025 and **90.1%** after the process automation rollout (+8.7 pts).
- **Bank Details Change** requests have the lowest SLA compliance (70.1%), so they are the first candidates for checklist and approval automation.
- **ADAGE** is the slowest ERP (81.8% SLA; average TAT 68% of the SLA target).
- Quarter-end rush drops SLA compliance to **76.5%** vs 88.9% on normal days, so plan extra capacity for the last week of each quarter.
- The top 2 rejection reasons (**Missing supporting documents**, **Duplicate request / record exists**) cause 56% of rejections; a mandatory-document checklist at intake would cut most rework.
- Open backlog: **28** tickets, of which **4** have already breached SLA.
